name: Derive V2
notes: derivexyz org has v2-core/v2-matching/v2-aa (active) but NO V2 subgraph/indexer. The derivexyz/subgraph repo indexes Lyra V1 on Optimism, not Derive V2 (own OP-stack Derive Chain). No public V2 indexer.

name: Doppler Finance
notes: XRPL-based CeDeFi yield (XRPfi) using custodians (Fireblocks/Ceffu); non-EVM, custodial. Only a DefiLlama TVL adapter exists. No EVM-style subgraph/indexer.

name: Hyperithm
notes: Risk curator running vaults on Morpho; no own protocol contracts. hyperithm org has only DefiLlama-Adapters / sats adapters. Vault data served by Morpho's indexing, not a Hyperithm repo.

name: Aave V2

repos.scope: Official Aave protocol subgraphs covering V2 (ETH Mainnet V2, Polygon V2, Avalanche V2, plus testnets) and V3
repos.verified: WebFetched repo: README lists active V2 deployments (ETH/Polygon/Avalanche Mainnet V2) + config/subgraph templates; 279 commits

repos.scope: BGD Labs (Aave core dev) maintained fork of the Aave V2/V3 protocol subgraphs
repos.verified: Top search hit for Aave V2 subgraph code, maintained by BGD Labs (Aave core contributors)

notes: Aave V2 has official subgraphs in aave/protocol-subgraphs with explicit V2 network deployments; queryable on The Graph Explorer.

name: UNCX Network V2

repos.scope: Official UNCX Lockers V2 subgraph (Uniswap-V2/SushiSwap-V2 liquidity lockers), multi-chain (Arbitrum/ETH/BNB); documented at developers.uncx.network with entities/queries; deployed on The Graph Explorer (subgraph id 5gByjbCu558gLVwzvWiYD8JPQC8KLk6PSe9AVFy8LC69)
repos.verified: UNCX official docs document the Lockers V2 subgraph with sample queries/entities; live on The Graph Explorer

notes: UNCX (formerly Unicrypt) publishes official subgraphs on The Graph for its liquidity lockers incl. V2. Contract repos at github.com/uncx-network; subgraph source published via The Graph deployments.

name: edgeX Bridge
notes: edgeX is a StarkEx orderbook DEX; the 'bridge' is the canonical StarkEx deposit/withdrawal. Balances off-chain in StarkEx, not indexable via standard EVM subgraphs. No public indexer repo.

name: BloFin
notes: Centralized custodial exchange. No on-chain protocol to index; no public subgraph/indexer.

name: Mellow Core
notes: mellow-finance org (mellow-vaults, mellow-lrt, simple-lrt, etc.) is smart contracts + tooling only — no subgraph.yaml/ponder.config/project.yaml. ERC4626 vaults but no public indexer published.

name: Midas RWA
notes: Midas tokenization (mTBILL, mBASIS ERC-20s). Only contracts/audit material + a DefiLlama adapter public; no dedicated subgraph/indexer repo. Standard ERC-20s with custodial backing.
